# Recovery Language

## Terminology Set

This note defines service recovery, failure handling, support diagnosis, outage communication, rollback wording, blast radius language, and other terms used in incident updates. It exists so people can describe a problem consistently across status notes, customer messages, and post-incident summaries.

## Communication Usage

The emphasis is naming. The note explains what operators usually mean by containment, mitigation, safe state, rollback, degradation, escalation, and monitoring recovery. It may resemble the playbook lexically because the same words appear in real incidents, but it does not guide the sequence of decisions required to restore service under pressure.

## Reference Scope

Use this note as vocabulary support for communication. Do not treat it as the action guide for narrowing the fault, deciding rollback safety, or restoring service without widening the blast radius.
